Weber Singapore lists 'pressure grouting, epoxy crack repair' under concrete repair, but its product listing could not be read. Saint-Gobain's injection resins are sold under GCP (DE NEEF) and Fosroc (Nitofill).
No water-reactive PU injection foam found in Weber's reachable ranges (see inj/P4).
No epoxy crack-injection resin confirmed; Weber Singapore mentions 'epoxy crack repair' but the product could not be read (see inj/P4).
